description: Internal changes to some door openings, minor setting out, addition of insulation and minor changes to front entrance doors to the dwellings being built in accordance with listed building consent 21/03325/LBC
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_:
21/03325/LBC
Variation of conditon1 of listed building consent dated 14 April 2020 (RN: 20/00004/LBC) (which varied listed building consent dated 29 April
2016 (RN: 15/10368/LBC)) for 'Substantial demolition and redevelopment behind retained front facades as well as the demolition and
reconstruction of mews properties to create two single family dwellinghouses. Associated alterations and extensions include subterranean
basements, which will extend beneath the mews, part courtyard and the rear sections of the listed buildings; re-instatement of the party wall in
the rear courtyard; re-instatement of entrance to no.108; rear lower ground floor extensions partially infilling the rear courtyard and with roof
terraces above; construction of full height closet wing extensions; reconstruction of mansard roof extension; installation of mechanical plant;
and internal alterations on all floor levels(Site includes nos. 107- 108EatonSquareandnos. 107-108EcclestonMews)'. NAMELY, to allow
changes to the roof of the lower ground floor link to form a roof terrace, change to the lower ground floor fenestration, change to the new rear
outrigger fenestration detail to ensure consistency with adjacent fenestration, addition of orangery to replace rear ground floor roof terrace,
and internal changes to the main houses.
